title: Italian for your trip to Italy
metaDescription: A few online Italian lessons before your trip, built around the places you will visit and the words you will really use. Taught by a native Italian.
intro: You don't need perfect Italian. But if you can order at a trattoria, ask for directions and chat with the lady at the market, the whole trip changes. A few online lessons before you go, from anywhere in the US, built around your trip.
heroImageAlt: A narrow street in an Italian town

sections.heading: What you learn
sections.body: The Italian you will really use: greetings and small talk, ordering food and wine, trains and tickets, markets and shops, asking for directions, and the small polite phrases that make Italians smile. Everything is planned around your itinerary, so the lessons use the names of the towns you are going to.

sections.heading: How it works
sections.body:
Online lessons on video, from wherever you are.

[EXAMPLE] Most people do six to eight lessons in the month or two before they leave, one or two a week. Traveling with a partner or friends? You can learn together.

sections.heading: And the trip itself
sections.body: Being Italian has a bonus. If you want, Valentina helps you build the itinerary: which towns to see and where to eat, with the places tourists miss. Tell her where you are thinking of going and she takes it from there.

faq.q: I leave in three weeks. Is it too late?
faq.a: No. Even three or four lessons give you the phrases you will use every day. Tell Valentina your date and she plans around it.

faq.q: Do I need to be in Atlanta?
faq.a: No. These lessons are online, from anywhere.

faq.q: Can you help with the itinerary even if I don't take lessons?
faq.a: [EXAMPLE] Yes. Ask in your inquiry and Valentina will tell you how it works.
